title: Touchpoint docket — morning triage and QBR seeds
content:
Quick morning scratchpad — meant for my flow, not polished.

TOPLINE (30s): focus today = 1) close renewal asks for ZephyrAI & OrbitMed, 2) get QBR metrics pulled for AstraHealth + Nimbus, 3) unblock Prod errors for BetaRetail (CS-4821). Prioritize time blocks: morning 9:00–11:30 deep follow-ups; 1:00–2:00 QBR pulls; 3:00–4:30 calls + prep.

MORNING TRIAGE (runbook):
- Check CS slack #support-high for anything flagged overnight (esp model OOMs).
- Ticket sweep: filter by priority: P0/P1 -> list below.
- Pull p95 latency, error rate, token burn for top 5 customers (Astra, Zephyr, Orbit, Nimbus, BetaRetail). Note: for QBR include cost per 1k tokens last 30d.

HOT TICKETS / ACTIONS:
- CS-4821 (BetaRetail) — Prod errors showing on generate-step; stack traces point to KV cache eviction on long sessions -> ping infra-oncall + attach repro logs. Owner: Samira. ETA: EOD. Slack: @raj-infra.
- CS-4999 (ZephyrAI renewal negotiation) — they asked for 15% discount + 6-month ramp, finance needs usage baseline. Action: compile 90-day usage + projected month-by-month. Draft email below. Owner: Samira + Maya. Deadline: 2026-09-20.
- CS-5012 (OrbitMed compliance questions) — needs KMS/HSM doc + audit logs example. Attach private-deployments compliance sheet and request SSO cert. Owner: Ethan. Follow-up 9/19.

RENEWALS SNAP (short notes):
- ZephyrAI (contract expire 2026-10-15) — renewal in negotiation. Key ask: lower unit price on embeddings, commit to 3-month reserved capacity. Risk: churn if discount denied. Prep: usage by endpoint, top 10 heavy routes.
- OrbitMed (2026-11-01) — interested in Private deployment path + HIPAA package. Must confirm timeline for on-prem trial. Sales lead: Nia.
- Nimbus (2027-01-10) — low-touch, likely auto-renew. Use QBR to upsell Optimize bundle.

QBR PREP NOTES (AstraHealth & Nimbus):
- Metrics to include: tokens generated (30/60/90d), mean latency p50/p95, error rate %, top 5 prompts by volume, cost per 1k tokens, KV-cache hit rate (if available), model version used.
- Ask engineering for small snapshot of model perf differences between v2.1 and v2.2 for long-context (JIRA: PERF-1128).
- Include 2 user stories: a) success story (reduced inference time after batch tuning), b) one outstanding risk (regression in structured output for lab-reports).
- Slide seeds: 1) agenda & objectives, 2) last quarter wins, 3) metrics + ops deep dive, 4) roadmap asks, 5) decisions needed (scale, SLAs, contract).

CALL SCRIPTS / EMAIL DRAFTS (short):
- Zephyr quick email draft: "Thanks for the transparency on pricing. Attached is a 90-day usage baseline and two proposed renewal options (standard + reserved burst). We can set a 30‑minute call Thur/Fri to align. If preferred, I can pull a month-by-month projection for finance. — Samira"
- BetaRetail escalation DM: "Raj — quick ping on CS-4821. Repro logs attached. We see KV cache evictions at ~55k tokens in session. Requesting kernel fallback enablement or config tweak. Can you confirm ETA?"

NOTES TO SELF / FLAGS:
- Ask infra for temporary increase to KV cache limits for BetaRetail repro. If not possible, propose canary rollback.
- For QBR, ask product to confirm any model-variant rollouts that hit AstraHealth during last 30d (to explain regressions).
- Check whether Optimize recommendations were applied for Nimbus — if yes, capture before/after cost delta.

UNRESOLVED QUESTIONS:
- Zephyr: do they want committed monthly spend or RU (reserved units) contract? Clarify on call.
- OrbitMed: what is the expected timeline for legal review on HIPAA addendum? Could block onboarding.

MEETING BLOCKS (today):
- 09:30 — BetaRetail incident sync (15m) — Raj, Devops, Samira.
- 11:00 — Zephyr renewal alignment (30m) — Maya + Zephyr procurement.
- 13:00 — QBR metric pull (self).
- 15:00 — AstraHealth QBR prep (30m) — include product.

QUICK CHECKLIST (tick when done):
[ ] Pull 30/60/90 day metrics for top 5 customers (Astra, Zephyr, Orbit, Nimbus, BetaRetail).
[ ] Draft Zephyr renewal + send.
[ ] Attach compliance doc for OrbitMed.
[ ] Escalate CS-4821 to infra + get ETA.
[ ] Seed QBR slides (2 metrics slides + 1 ops slide).

MISC SCRIBBLES / REMINDERS:
- Keep email language tight: metrics + ask in 1–2 bullets.
- Save snapshots of dashboards as PNGs for slides (avoid live links in QBR).
- If BetaRetail still failing after infra patch, escalate to SRE lead for war room.

END NOTES: this is a rolling scratchpad. Will move final QBR slides to Confluence page and mark doc as final once slides are uploaded.
